title: Combining LLM and Dynamic Analysis for Universal Testing of Static Application Security Testing Tools
abstract: arXiv:2610.21309v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Static application security testing (SAST) tools help detect potential software vulnerabilities, but they themselves contain faults undermining reliability and usability. Automated testing can address these issues, yet current techniques suffer from limited program transformation diversity and lack mechanisms to verify generated variants, leading to reduced fault detection and high manual effort. We present LLM4SAST, the first universal framework detecting faults in SAST tools using large language models and dynamic feedback. Our key insight is leveraging LLMs to understand and transform code in diverse programming languages. We design novel metamorphic relations with transformations to guide variant generation, using an LLM to produce multi-language variants that satisfy these relations. To reduce erroneous variants and identify unique faults, we propose two heuristics: dynamic-feedback-driven selection and program-differencing-based

translated_title: 结合大语言模型与动态分析实现静态应用程序安全测试工具的通用测试
translated_abstract: 静态应用程序安全测试（SAST）工具有助于检测潜在的软件漏洞，但它们自身也存在缺陷，损害了其可靠性和可用性。自动化测试可以解决这些问题，然而现有技术存在程序变换多样性有限、且缺乏验证所生成变体的机制等问题，导致缺陷检测能力下降且人工成本高昂。我们提出了LLM4SAST，这是首个利用大语言模型和动态反馈来检测SAST工具缺陷的通用框架。我们的核心洞察是利用大语言模型来理解并变换多种编程语言的代码。我们设计了新颖的蜕变关系及相应变换来指导变体生成，并使用大语言模型生成满足这些关系的多语言变体。为了减少错误变体并识别独特缺陷，我们提出了两种启发式方法：动态反馈驱动的选择和基于程序差分的方法。
tldr: 提出LLM4SAST，首个结合大语言模型与动态反馈来检测静态应用安全测试工具缺陷的通用框架，通过蜕变关系引导的多语言代码变体生成实现自动化测试。
en_tdlr: LLM4SAST, the first universal framework that combines large language models and dynamic feedback to detect faults in SAST tools through metamorphic-relation-guided multi-language variant generation.
